data.title: 卡提希娅 · 溪湾里的流浪骑士假日
data.description: 【埃格拉海岸溪湾·午后】卡提希娅穿着浅蓝长裙式泳装坐在溪海交界的石头上，脱下靴子让脚尖碰水，金发长辫落到肩前；她把一枚花冠放在膝上，对镜头露出久违的轻松笑容。
data.location: Egra coastal stream beside the sea
data.action: 溪海交界石头上脱靴试水，把花冠放膝上享受没有旅路的一天
data.lighting: clear afternoon light on river and surf
data.mood: 终于停下脚步的骑士假日
data.promptProse: Cartethyia from Wuthering Waves wears a pale blue long-skirt swimsuit with a cream cardigan and a gold braid. She sits where the river meets the sea, boots set aside while her toes test the cool water. A small flower crown rests on her knees, and she looks toward the viewer with the unguarded smile of a wandering knight enjoying a day without a road to follow. clear afternoon light on river and surf.
